items.title: Ookwemin St 7 m Southeast of Villiers St to 93 m Southeast of Villiers St
items.description: Toronto-TMC: The proposed scope of work includes the advancement of 5 boreholes to a maximum depth of fifteen (15) metres below grade (mbg) within the roadway and public right-of-way along northwest portion of Ookwemin Street. All 5 boreholes will be completed as monitoring wells using 50 mm diameter Schedule 40 PVC pipe with 3-metre screens and flushto-grade casings. The work will be conducted using hydrovac to daylight locations first, followed by hollow-stem auguring, and each borehole/monitoring well will be sampled for soil and groundwater. Traffic control measures, including signage, barriers, and personnel, will be implemented where required, and the boreholes may require daylighting to safely expose underground utilities prior to drilling.

Equipment includes skid steer, scissor lift/boom lift, traffic barrels and signs. Temporary alternating lane closures will be used in both the EB and WB directions simultaneously while maintaining at least one lane of traffic in both directions. One sidewalk is to be closed continuously to facilitate the safe storage of necessary equipment. One sidewalk to remain opened at all times. Pedestrians to be detoured from closed sidewalk to opened sidewalk at nearest crossings. A maximum of 1 lane + HOV would be closed in the EBL and WBL simultaneously.

items.title: – Long Branch Loop Streetcar Track Renewal Work
items.description:
With the start of the TTC construction at Long Branch Loop service will be adjusted on the following routes: 
 
501 Queen: 501A Queen streetcar will be extended to operate in the late evening period between Neville Park Loop and Humber Loop. Streetcars will continue to arrive every 10 minutes. 
 
Service on the 501C Queen will be suspended during this construction period. 
 
301 Queen: Overnight service on the 301 Queen streetcar will be shortened to operate between Neville Park Loop and Humber Loop. 
 
301L Queen bus replacement service will be introduced between Long Branch Loop and Dufferin Gate Loop via The Queensway, Park Lawn Road and Lake Shore Boulevard West. Buses will arrive every 30 minutes. 
 
507 Long Branch: Service on the 507 Long Branch streetcar will be suspended and replaced by 507 Long Branch bus replacement service. 
 
507 Long Branch bus replacement service will operate between Humber Loop and Long Branch Loop via Lake Shore Boulevard West, Park Lawn Road and The Queensway. 
 
Buses will arrive every 10 minutes and be extended into the late evening period to replace suspended 501C Queen streetcar service. 
 
507M Long Branch bus replacement shuttle service will begin operating between Humber Loop and Humber Bay Shores (Marine Parade Drive and Silver Moon Drive) via The Queensway, Park Lawn Road, Lake Shore Boulevard West and Marine Parade Drive.
 
Buses will arrive 15 minutes during the weekday peak periods and between 20 and 30 minutes in off peak periods. 
 
Service on the 508 Lake Shore streetcar will be suspended for the summer.

512B St Clair bus replacement service will be introduced between Gunns Loop and Lansdowne Station. 
 
Eastbound buses will operate via St Clair Avenue West, Lansdowne Avenue, Dupont Street, Symington Avenue, Bloor Street West and Lansdowne Avenue. 
 
Westbound buses will operate via Lansdowne Avenue and St Clair Avenue West. 
 
During the overnight period, bus service on 340 Junction will be extended to Oakwood Avenue via St Clair Avenue West.

Eastbound 506B/306B Carlton replacement buses will continue to operate via Spadina Avenue, College Street, Carlton Street, Parliament Street, and Gerrard Street East. 
 
506/306 Carlton streetcars will continue to divert via Bay Street, Dundas Street, and Parliament Street while construction activities remain underway within the corridor. 
 
Please note: These route changes will not be reflected on the TTC’s Routes and Schedules pages or most trip‑planning apps.

Westbound: from Wolseley Loop, south on Bathurst Street and west on Queen Street West/The Queensway, to Sunnyside Loop. 
Eastbound: from Sunnyside Loop, east on The Queensway/Queen Street West, north on Bathurst Street and east on Wolseley Street, to Wolseley Loop.

items.title: – Temporary route change due to CIBC Run for the Cure
items.description:
505/305 Dundas streetcars will divert both ways on McCaul Street, Queen Street West and Bathurst Street. 
 
Stops not served: Dundas Street West between Bathurst and McCaul streets.

items.title: – Temporary route change due to CIBC Run for the Cure
items.description:
October 4, 2026
 
7 a.m. to 1 p.m.
 
506/306 Carlton streetcars will operate a split route as follows:
Westside streetcars will turn back at Bathurst Station via Ossington Avenue, Dundas Street West and Bathurst Street. 
Eastside streetcars will operate as follows: 
Westbound: south on Parliament Street, west on Dundas Street East/West, north on Bay Street and west on College Street. 
Eastbound: south on McCaul Street, east on Dundas Street West/East, north on Parliament Street and east on Gerrard Street East, to regular route.
 
7 a.m. to 2 p.m.
 
506/306 Carlton replacement buses will operate between Bathurst Station and Parliament Street and Gerrard Street East as follows: 
Eastbound: east on Bloor Street West, south Queen’s Park Crescent West, east on College/Carlton streets and south on Parliament Street, to Gerrard Street East. 
Westbound: north on Parliament Street, west on Carlton Street, north on Yonge Street, west on Wellesley Street West, south on Bay Street, west on College Street, north on Queen’s Park Crescent East and west on Bloor Street West, to Bathurst Station.
 
Stops not served: College Street between Ossington Avenue and McCaul Street. 
 
Transfer points:
Westbound buses: board on the north side of Gerrard Street East, east of Parliament Street. 
Eastbound streetcars: board on the east side of Parliament Street, south of Gerrard Street East.

items.title: – Route update, streetcar service resumes
items.description:
512/312 St Clair streetcars will resume regular routing between St Clair Station and Gunns Loop. 
 
512B St Clair replacement buses will operate north on Weston Road, and west and south on Gunns Road. Buses will not enter Gunns Loop. 
 
Board replacement buses at curbside stops.
